description: Retrieves NCBI BioProject metadata — title, description, organism, submitter and release dates — for a batch of BioProject accessions, using the official NCBI E-utilities API rather than scraping the BioProject web pages. Supports keyword filtering over titles and descriptions, CSV/JSON export, and requires a contact email as the NCBI usage policy mandates. This skill should be used when looking up what a BioProject or PRJNA/PRD accession contains, retrieving sequencing project descriptions, or collecting BioProject metadata in bulk is requested.
